project: Des Moines AI Pulse — iOS Layout & Monetization
description: Bring the native iOS app (DesMoinesInsider, Swift/SwiftUI, currently v1.1.30) to full feature parity with the web/desktop product and maximize revenue across BOTH engines in parallel: (1) consumer subscriptions via StoreKit IAP and (2) local advertising/sponsored inventory (mostly outside Apple's commission). The app already ships a strong native base (6-tab shell, StoreKit 2 + cross-platform entitlement sync, account deletion, privacy manifest, affiliate ads, PremiumGate, Ask Pulse AI / Swipe / Surprise Me, App Clip, security & platform services) — those are recorded here as passes:true baselines. The new work: a content-first Home + Discover-hub information architecture so every web surface is reachable; a unified card/skeleton system; sticky search + persistent filter chips; a contextual paywall with per-feature placement, annual SKUs, trials, and win-back offers; first-party campaign ad serving, sponsored/featured listings, native in-feed + capped interstitial ads, house-ad fill, AI-flow sponsored placements, advertiser self-serve linkout, and ad analytics parity; native builds of Trip Planner, Articles/Guides, Stay, Weekend, Best-Of voting, Music/Sports/Outdoors/Neighborhood hubs, Dashboard, saved searches/alerts, reviews, and Deals; plus iPad adaptivity, personalization, and an accessibility/offline/store-readiness pass. Ralph picks the first story with passes:false.
